path.description: Path relative to the agent folder '{agent_folder}', e.g. reports/chart.png

target.description: Path in the local workspace; a folder (an existing one, or any path ending in /, which is created) keeps the file's name, e.g. jobs/heating-oil/ or jobs/heating-oil/chart.png

overwrite.description: Replace a file of that name in the workspace (default false)
